proposed_chunks.literary_form: Dated word-event and quoted communal objection
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Regnal-date and vayehi devar YHWH beyad Haggai lead through le'mor into koh amar and the people's time statement.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach the date heading or absorb both opening word-events.
proposed_chunks.risk: Date, addressee, doubled time wording, quotation attachment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The messenger formula introduces the saying; renewed vayehi devar at 1:3 marks the next event.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Renewed word, house contrast, and first consider-your-ways diagnosis
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Vayehi devar restarts speech; haet lakhem leads to koh amar, first simu levavkhem, and patterned futility catalogue.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Treat 1:3 as a free heading or merge both panels without distinction.
proposed_chunks.risk: Punctuation, paneled-house term, infinitives, scarcity causality.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: The pierced-bag image closes diagnosis; koh amar plus repeated simu levavkhem at 1:7 resets to command.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Second consider-your-ways exhortation, build command, and drought explanation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Repeated formula opens a panel; alu-havetem-uvnu gives action, followed by yaan meh and al-ken through the drought catalogue.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split command from rationale or make harev/horev a root ruling.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Imperatives and first-person acts cohere; vayyishma at 1:12 switches to narrated response.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Obedience, messenger assurance, stirred response, and dated work commencement
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Vayyishma, compact ani ittekhem, repeated vayyaer et-ruach, arrival/work, and sixth-month date form a narrative progression.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate 1:13, detach the work date, or decide ruach ontology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Wayyiqtol sequence binds the response; the seventh-month word frame at 2:1 opens a distinct event.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Fresh date addresses three constituencies; questions yield repeated chazaq, work, ani ittekhem, al-tira'u, then ki koh amar gives shaking and house rationale.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split encouragement from rationale or decide a preferred fulfillment reading.
proposed_chunks.risk: Covenant syntax, ruach, compressed timing, chemdat nations, glory, peace.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: House/glory binds questions to close; new ninth-month date at 2:10 ends the event.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Ninth-month dated Torah inquiry and prophetic application
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Date-word frame gives sheal-na et-hakkohanim Torah; two touch questions receive answers, followed by vaya'an Haggai and threefold ken.
proposed_chunks.risk: Purity transfer, priest speech, referents, sham, ritual inference.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Question-answer and deixis bind dialogue; veattah simu-na at 2:15 shifts to temporal retrospective.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Consider-from-this-day retrospective and prospective blessing turn
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Repeated min-hayyom hazzeh vamalah frames deficient measures and blow catalogue, then foundation/seed inventory turns to min-hayyom hazzeh avarekh.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split at 2:18 or choose one vamalah sense as authoritative.
proposed_chunks.risk: Temporal adverb, measures, ve'en etkhem elay, foundation date, seed question, blessing chronology.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Repeated consider/from-this-day language binds movement; vayehi devar shenit at 2:20 starts another word.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Second same-day kingdom-overthrow and Zerubbabel signet oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Vayehi devar YHWH shenit distinguishes the word; emor el-Zerubbavel narrows address; repeated vehafakhti leads to bayyom hahu signet close.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Merge automatically with first same-day word, split signet close, or decide identity/fulfillment.
